differences.a_observable: Strong cool blue color cast across the white tiles and background.
differences.b_observable: Neutral grey and white tiles with no blue color cast.
differences.fix: Add a cool blue ambient light or adjust color grading to introduce a blue cast.

differences.a_observable: High contrast with bright highlights on the card surfaces and deep shadows in the crevices.
differences.b_observable: Flat lighting with low contrast, washed-out shadows, and dull highlights.
differences.fix: Adjust the light intensity and shadow bias to increase contrast and deepen shadows.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned closer to the cards, creating a dynamic perspective with visible depth of field blur in the background.
differences.b_observable: The camera is further away, resulting in a flatter perspective and uniform sharpness.
differences.fix: Move the camera closer and adjust focal length and depth of field settings.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the lighting setup to introduce the cool blue color cast and increase contrast to match the reference.
